note: Burundi: nationals of the East African Community's other states enter without a visa for 3 months, Hong Kong's for 14 days; everyone else gets a visa on arrival for 30 days (or an online visa, USD 90 a month). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Burundi
sources.said: Visitors to Burundi may obtain either a visa on arrival or an Online Visa unless they are citizens from one of the visa-exempt countries. ... 3 months Democratic Republic of Congo Kenya Rwanda South Sudan Tanzania Uganda 14 days Hong Kong ... Citizens of other countries and territories may obtain a visa on arrival either at Bujumbura International Airport ( Melchior Ndadaye ) or at all land borders for a maximum stay of 30 days.
